title: agent-browser subprocess driver (open/close lifecycle, observation, screenshots)
acceptance: packages/runner/src/browser/agent-browser-session.ts: AgentBrowserSession class wrapping a long-lived `agent-browser --session <runId>` subprocess
Methods: open(url, opts), snapshot() → { origin, snapshot, refs }, click(ref), fill(ref, text), scroll(direction), back(), screenshot(path), close()
Subprocess stdout/stderr piped into a callback so the runner can log `agent_browser_io` lines
On signal/abort, daemon shuts down without leaking chrome processes
Allowlist passed via --allowed-domains; viewport via --viewport mobile|wxh
Tests: a mock subprocess strategy verifies all command shapes; an integration test against `examples/ecommerce-checkout` (port 3100) is gated on AGENT_BROWSER_E2E=1
